item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:50 HKT 16/Jan/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will affect Guangdong in the next couple of days. The weather will be cool with a few rain patches over the region. Under the influence of a strong easterly airstream, it will be windy over the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of this week. An upper-air disturbance is expected to bring rainy weather to the region on Friday and over the weekend.
